title: Atlas Maior, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description In the age of great discoveries, a map was an invitation to cross the boundaries of the known world. The “Atlas Maior” coin is a tribute to the ambition that once enabled explorers to give shape and names to lands still waiting to be discovered. Thanks to two transparent magnifying lenses, every collector can personally step into the intricate lines and details, discovering the artistry of historical cartography captured in pure silver. This coin was created for those who value clear direction, insatiable curiosity, and the quiet discipline of following their own course.
